title.narrative: Development of strategic interventions for improving water and wastewater services in Palestinian refugee camps

description.narrative:
The overall objective of the Action is to improve water and wastewater services in the Palestinian refugee camps in Palestine and hosting countries.

The purpose is to:

- Assess water and wastewater services for refugee camps and their management efficiency and sustainability

- Define development needs to enhance the level of services provided to refugees.

- Develop a priority action plan for implementation; and

- Propose an institutional arrangements to improve services.
